title: Chronicles of Kings - Storage
description: Harness the power of crystal to store, sort, and shape your kingdom’s legacy.
body:
### 💠 CoK Storage – Scalable Inventory for High-Performance Worlds


CoK Storage is a streamlined, crystal-themed inventory system designed for large-scale item management without the overhead. 

Built for speed, simplicity, and seamless integration, it offers a modular solution that scales effortlessly from humble workshops to sprawling kingdom vaults.

• 	Auto-Powered Architecture: No external energy systems required—storage blocks are self-sufficient, enabling plug-and-play setup across any build.

• 	Crystal-Themed Design: Inspired by ancient crystalline aesthetics, each block features clean visuals and thematic cohesion with the Chronicles of Kings mod suite.

• 	Massive Scalability: Designed to handle high item throughput and large inventories with minimal performance impact, making it ideal for late-game builds and automation-heavy worlds.

• 	Tier-Agnostic Containers: Storage blocks support tiered upgrades and sorting logic, allowing players to customize capacity and behavior without rigid progression.

• 	Crafting Integration: Direct access to stored items from crafting interfaces ensures smooth recipe execution and supports modular crafting systems.
